text:
maya_k: Quick heads-up — final onsite for Infra Eng is scheduled Wed 2:30–3:30 PT. Need: scribe, AV host (recording + transcript consent), someone to own infra/backend rubric, and a debrief lead who can run 3:35–3:50. Can folks ping availability?

samir_patel: I can scribe. @maya_k can you add me to the calendar invite? Prefer to take notes in the shared doc instead of meeting chat.

priya: I can own the infra/backend rubric. Which rubric variant are we using — infra-specific or generic backend template? Link?

maya_k: Thanks both. Use the infra-specific rubric (link below). I'll paste the link in calendar and the shared doc. <https://redwood.company/internal/rubrics/infra-engineer-v2>

elena: Happy to be debrief lead — I can run 3:35–3:50 PT and capture action items. Will need the scribe notes by 3:34.

samir_patel: Cool. Quick clarification on weighting — do we use the standard infra weights or adjust for heavy systems design? I was thinking design 50%, systems/ops 30%, communication 20%.

priya: Yep that matches my expectation for this role. I'll annotate the rubric with those weights and call out the three anchor questions for system design.

people-ops-bot: Reminder: please get candidate consent for recording/transcript at least 24h before interview. Template: 
"We record interviews for hiring calibration. If you prefer not to be recorded, let us know and we'll accommodate."

maya_k: @sre-oncall-bot can you reserve Quiet Room A (video + mic) and enable recording on the Zoom account for that slot? Also can we enable auto-transcript?

sre-oncall-bot: Reserved Quiet Room A for Wed 2:15–4:00 PT. Recording + auto-transcript enabled for the meeting link.

maya_k: Checklist for people: Zoom link in invite (done), rubric link (done), scribe assigned (samir), rubric owner (priya), debrief lead (elena), recording consent sent (I'll send now). If anyone needs to swap, flag here — otherwise I'll update invites and shared doc. :thumbsup:

samir_patel: :thumbsup: I'll drop a quick template in the notes doc for timestamps + highlights.

priya: Added the rubric edits and anchor questions. Leaving a short scoring example so reviewers know how to use the weights.

elena: Great. One tiny ask — can we limit debrief to strictly 15 minutes? We tend to drift. I'll call out must-decide vs follow-up.

maya_k: Agreed. I'll set a 15-minute meeting length for the debrief and add a decision section in the doc. Thanks everyone — I'll update calendar and ping candidate consent now.
